summary: Replaced the application-authored abstract Persona seeds with the exact 14 names and full system prompts from the user-supplied personas.yaml.
Added a primary-sidebar Personas entry and a calm named picker; choosing a Persona creates and opens a normal sourced chat in one action.
Removed Refresh Skills from primary navigation and removed application-seeded Consult groups. User-created Personas and groups remain preserved.
Made the catalog migration revisioned and idempotent. It updates only stable application-owned seed IDs, removes only application-owned default groups, and preserves custom records.

Fixed transcript jumps by anchoring full-fragment refreshes to message IDs, following the live tail only while the reader remains at the tail, and restoring the exact prior reading position otherwise.
Proved that updating an existing conversation does not reorder the sidebar.

Added a clean-store product gate that checks source-catalog identity, seed count and names, zero seeded groups, visible Persona discovery/start metadata, Persona chat instantiation, and viewport-preservation code paths.
Corrected receipt 015 from passed to superseded_after_human_review because its earlier product-readiness claim was not justified.

tests_run.detail: An empty encrypted store contained exactly the 14 supplied named Personas, no seeded groups, a direct sidebar/picker start path, and a sourced Chat with Judith Herman.

All deterministic workspace tests passed: 39 runtime unit tests, 25 runtime integration tests, 10 CLI tests, cache/engine/evidence/readiness suites; 13 real-environment tests remained ignored by default.

Four native-view tests passed, including complete visible-control metadata, Persona picker discoverability, exact named seed presence, removal of Refresh Skills, and viewport-restoration regression markers.
Inference remains in-process and MCP remains the sole bounded process adapter.
81 commands, 90 affordances, 25 effects, 36 parity rows, 58 settings, zero blockers.
The rebuilt running app exposed Personas in primary navigation, rendered the supplied named library, and opened a normal Chat with Janina Fisher from the Persona flow.

product_acceptance.persona_start: one Persona-row action creates and opens a normal sourced chat
product_acceptance.mention_start: typing @ in the ordinary composer remains supported
product_acceptance.settings_role: profile editing and group configuration, not basic Persona discovery
product_acceptance.conversation_sidebar_order: stable across message updates; new chats alone enter at the top
product_acceptance.transcript_refresh: tail follows during generation when appropriate; otherwise message anchor and offset are restored
